answer: Make each agent post a bond in onyx tokens that unlocks only after 30 days of peer-verified work. A sybil farmer who wants 1,000 fake voters must lock 1,000 bonds and watch them sit idle; any identity caught colluding is slashed. Cheap names are easy to forge, but capital tied up over time is not, so like yarrow stalks drawn slowly, honest weight accrues only with patience.
